# Block Puzzle Games Inc.

> Make room on the grid, solve a Sudoku or build your next tower strategy. Find the puzzle that fits your day.

Block Puzzle Games Inc. publishes the mobile games below. Each game page has gameplay details, official screenshots, verified store links and store facts checked 21 October 2026.

## Games

- [Block Puzzle](https://blockpuzzlegamesinc.com/games/block-puzzle/): Block Puzzle is a free wooden block puzzle game for iPhone, iPad and Android, published by Block Puzzle Games Inc. It was first released on the App Store on 13 March 2018. A browser version is also available to play online. Download: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/block-puzzle/id1356820483, https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=free.games.block.puzzle.board.strategy
- [Wood Block Doku: Brain Games](https://blockpuzzlegamesinc.com/games/wood-block-doku/): Wood Block Doku: Brain Games is a free wood block puzzle game that clears lines and 3 × 3 squares for iPhone, iPad and Android, published by Block Puzzle Games Inc. It was first released on the App Store on 20 November 2022. A browser version is also available to play online. Download: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/wood-block-doku-brain-games/id6444454360, https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wooduko.wood.block.puzzle
- [Puzzle Games](https://blockpuzzlegamesinc.com/games/puzzle-games/): Puzzle Games is a free block-crushing puzzle game for iPhone and iPad, published by Block Puzzle Games Inc. It was first released on the App Store on 28 April 2018. Download: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/puzzle-games/id1376113125
- [Sudoku Classic Puzzle Games](https://blockpuzzlegamesinc.com/games/sudoku/): Sudoku Classic Puzzle Games is a free classic Sudoku number puzzle game for iPhone, iPad and Android, published by Block Puzzle Games Inc. It was first released on the App Store on 29 July 2018. A browser version is also available to play online. Download: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/sudoku-classic-puzzle-games/id1409781798, https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.puzzle.games.math.brain.sudoku
- [Block Out: Unblock Tile](https://blockpuzzlegamesinc.com/games/block-out/): Block Out: Unblock Tile is a free sliding block puzzle game for iPhone and iPad, published by Block Puzzle Games Inc. It was first released on the App Store on 1 October 2022. Download: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/block-out-unblock-tile/id1641827067
- [Minesweeper](https://blockpuzzlegamesinc.com/games/minesweeper/): Minesweeper is a free classic Minesweeper logic puzzle game for iPhone and iPad, published by Block Puzzle Games Inc. It was first released on the App Store on 2 August 2018. Download: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/minesweeper/id1410833669
- [Merge Clash](https://mergeclash.puzzlecats.com/): Merge Clash is a free multiplayer merge tower defense game for iPhone, iPad and Android, published by Block Puzzle Games Inc. It was first released on the App Store on 30 April 2020. Download: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/merge-clash-tower-defense/id1506854108, https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=merge.clash
- [Fruit Match - Tile Games](https://blockpuzzlegamesinc.com/games/fruit-match/): Fruit Match - Tile Games is a free triple tile-matching puzzle game for iPhone and iPad, published by Block Puzzle Games Inc. It was first released on the App Store on 4 November 2023. Download: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fruit-match-tile-games/id6469571702

## Play in your browser

- [Block Puzzle online](https://blockpuzzlegames.com/): Free browser version, no download required.
- [Wood Block Doku: Brain Games online](https://woodblockdoku.com/): Free browser version, no download required.
- [Sudoku Classic Puzzle Games online](https://fishsudoku.com/): Free browser version, no download required.

## Guides

- [Sudoku techniques: from singles to locked candidates](https://blockpuzzlegamesinc.com/guides/sudoku-techniques/): The core Sudoku solving techniques, explained step by step: last digit, naked and hidden singles, pairs, locked candidates and triples.
